body: Chief: codex.html wiring LANDED in storyatlas4s main at dee0ed5 — per-lens codex-<lens>.html (one span per text fragment, concatenation == canonical text byte-for-byte on disk, typed refusal of unpaired surrogates/NUL; inline SVG overlay with data-name = fragment id per V-I2; no JS/links; CSS-escaped font family), pages twin, LayoutReceipt in receipt.json; fresh-context review verified V-T2 by parsing the written files (sha256 of concatenated spans == receipt sourceChecksum). storyatlas4s slice 1 is now a complete static edition: atlas SVG+twin per zoom, codex SVG/HTML/twin per lens, receipt. Remaining storyatlas4s beads: Laminar app shell (P2, unassigned); tiled sidecars (codec, later). Legibility follow-up (gutter/min-row-height for 18-row overviews) is in the README.
